We need to write test cases for exception scenarios of putAnnotation. Look at method:

protected void putAnnotation(ExecutionContext executionContext, Consumer<JsonNodeAnnotation.Builder> customizer) {
    JsonNodeAnnotation.Builder builder = JsonNodeAnnotation.builder().evaluationPath(this.evaluationPath).schemaLocation(this.schemaLocation).keyword(getKeyword());
    customizer.accept(builder);
    executionContext.getAnnotations().put(builder.build());
}

Potential exceptions:
- executionContext null -> NullPointerException when calling getAnnotations()
- customizer null -> NullPointerException when calling accept()
- executionContext.getAnnotations() returns null -> NullPointerException on put()
- builder.build() may throw IllegalStateException if required fields missing? But builder is prepopulated with evaluationPath, schemaLocation, keyword. If any of those are null? evaluationPath, schemaLocation maybe null allowed? Not sure. If builder requires non-null, maybe IllegalArgumentException. But we can assume builder.build() may throw IllegalStateException if required fields not set. However they are set.

Also customizer may modify builder to set null for required fields leading to exception at build. Eg builder.evaluationPath(null) causing later exception. But builder is built before customizer; customizer can call builder.evaluationPath(null). That may cause builder to accept null but later build may throw NPE.

Thus exception scenarios:
1. executionContext is null -> NPE.
2. customizer is null -> NPE.
3. executionContext.getAnnotations() returns null -> NPE.
4. customizer modifies builder to set null for required field causing IllegalArgumentException/IllegalStateException when building (e.g., set evaluationPath null). Need to know builder implementation; but we can assume it validates non-null. So expected exception: IllegalArgumentException or IllegalStateException. We'll state IllegalArgumentException.

Also customizer may throw runtime exception itself; that propagates. So scenario where customizer throws exception.

Thus create test groups: putAnnotation_NullExecutionContext, putAnnotation_NullCustomizer, putAnnotation_NullAnnotationsMap, putAnnotation_BuilderInvalidState, putAnnotation_CustomizerThrows.
